title: Archive Reaction — Measured Restraint
motionDescription: Vesper Ink receives Kuro Signal's incomplete fragment slip at the archive workbench, inspects the missing gaps under cyan CRT glow, calmly halts Kuro's eager rush with a vertical brass stylus gesture, taps the two blank zones, and settles into a composed restraint hold.

reducedMotionAlternative.description: Held composed two-shot of Vesper Ink framing the incomplete signal sheet with a yellow binder clip ready while Kuro Signal settles back listening.

frames.actingNote: Kuro slides portable receiver and signal slip onto Vesper's desk; Vesper waist-up in warm lamp pool looks down calmly.
Vesper reaches deliberately with both hands and brass stylus poised, lifting the slip toward the cyan CRT glow.
Medium close-up on Vesper waist-up; goggles catch cyan/violet glint as eyes pause sharply on the missing blank gaps.
Split-energy two-shot: Kuro leans eagerly gesturing to ship it now; Vesper stays rooted and raises one hand and brass stylus vertically.
Vesper lowers the slip to the blotter with a knowing half-smile and taps the two blank gap zones with the brass stylus.
Vesper rests hands cleanly framing the incomplete sheet with yellow binder clip ready; Kuro settles back listening.
